sections.label: Toilets at selected park locations
sections.summary: Toilets will be built at selected locations conveniently placed to serve park users and the local community.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: As the network is extensive, these toilets will be built at selected locations that are conveniently located where they can best serve park users and the local community.

sections.label: NParks toilet feasibility studies
sections.summary: NParks will study building toilets where unavailable, with regional parks planned at 500-metre to one-kilometre intervals depending on factors.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: At areas where such facilities are not available, NParks will study the feasibility of building toilets.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: For regional parks that are meant to serve park users beyond the immediate vicinity, the planning parameter is to provide toilets at every 500-metre to one-kilometre intervals depending on other factors, such as terrain, availability of space, proximity to sewer lines and so on.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: For public parks where spaces are available and where there can be cost-effective connections to existing sewer lines, NParks will study the feasibility of providing toilets.
